themes_detail.label: Traffic Safety Spike
themes_detail.summary: Traffic complaints surged to 5 this week compared to a 1.1 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks—a 344% spike (z-score: 4.96)—suggesting a sudden and acute street safety or congestion problem emerging in Crown Heights/Prospect Heights right now.
evidence: 5 traffic complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.1 weekly average (344% increase)
Z-score of 4.96 indicates statistically significant anomaly
No prior reporting or community board discussion on file—suggests new, unreported problem
reporting_angles: Street-by-street canvassing: which corridors are residents reporting congestion or safety issues, and why now?
DOE or city planning angle: are new construction permits (496 filed in 90 days) creating unexpected traffic disruptions?

themes_detail.label: Unsanitary Conditions Doubling
themes_detail.summary: Unsanitary condition complaints more than doubled to 111 last week versus a 53.0 weekly average (109% increase, z-score: 9.77)—the highest z-score spike in the district—indicating a sudden deterioration in cleanliness across blocks or facilities, likely tied to sanitation service gaps residents have repeatedly budgeted for.
evidence: 111 unsanitary condition complaints last week vs. 53.0 weekly baseline (109% spike)
Highest z-score in district dataset (9.77)—most statistically anomalous issue
Community Board has repeatedly requested 'Other cleaning requests' to Department of Sanitation, suggesting chronic underfunding or service failures
reporting_angles: Where specifically are complaints clustered? (block-by-block map of 311 filings)
Are sanitation truck routes/schedules changing, or is illegal dumping/homelessness accelerating?

themes_detail.label: Graffiti Surge
themes_detail.summary: Graffiti complaints jumped to 14 last week from a 2.2 weekly average—a 522% spike (z-score: 7.94)—indicating either a coordinated tagging campaign, gang activity, or deferred removal maintenance in Crown Heights/Prospect Heights.
evidence: 14 graffiti complaints last week vs. 2.2 weekly average (522% increase)
Z-score of 7.94 indicates statistically significant, concentrated outbreak
Aligns with 700% spike in Illegal Tree Damage complaints (6 vs. 0.8 avg), suggesting potential youth disorder or gang activity
reporting_angles: Visual reporting: document the tagging patterns—same tags, crew names, locations—to identify if this is organized vs. opportunistic
NYPD liaison angle: are precincts aware of a gang tag surge or organized tagging campaign?

themes_detail.label: Outdoor Dining Complaints Spike
themes_detail.summary: Outdoor dining complaints spiked to 3 last week from a near-zero 0.1 weekly baseline—a 2,300% increase (z-score: 8.69)—suggesting new indoor-to-outdoor dining conversions, encroachment disputes, or noise/crowding conflicts emerging on the district's commercial corridors.
evidence: 3 outdoor dining complaints last week vs. 0.1 weekly average (2,300% increase)
Z-score of 8.69, second-highest statistical anomaly in dataset
No prior local news coverage or community board discussion—indicates newly visible problem
reporting_angles: Which restaurants or blocks are residents complaining about? Are new permanent sheds or seating appearing post-COVID?
Zoning angle: are commercial expansions under-permitted or exceeding curb space allocations?

themes_detail.label: Electrical Hazards Emerging
themes_detail.summary: Electrical complaints jumped to 3 last week from a 0.2 weekly average—a 1,100% spike (z-score: 6.35)—potentially signaling downed power lines, exposed wiring, or overloaded building systems amid intense construction activity (496 permits filed in 90 days).
evidence: 3 electrical complaints last week vs. 0.2 weekly average (1,100% increase)
Z-score of 6.35 indicates statistically significant anomaly
Coincides with spike in General Construction/Plumbing complaints (41 two weeks ago vs. 11.5 avg, z-score: 4.37)—suggests construction-related hazards
reporting_angles: Safety inspection angle: are Con Edison or FDNY aware of recent electrical hazards in Crown Heights? Any incidents filed?
DOB/construction angle: are 496 active permits being monitored for safety compliance, particularly near electrical infrastructure?
